thesis: Automating the edit only pays off if the output is postable as-is; a tool that hands back clips you still have to fix has moved the work, not removed it.
frame: A dishwasher that returns the plates still dirty: the cycle finished in minutes, but you are standing at the sink washing up anyway.

throughline.name: the-clip-card
throughline.description: One vertical short-form clip rectangle standing in for a single output clip: the thing both tools promise to hand you.
throughline.evolution: Opens as a bare grey rectangle behind the pain statement (fast, but empty). Picks up raw unstyled auto-captions where OpusClip's speed is described. Picks up styled captions, emphasis and native layout where Submagic's polish is described. Ends as two cards side by side: one ready to post, one still wearing a fix-list badge.
